# möbius for macOS 0.3.11

- Includes Core and gateway 0.16.6, with the Sol 6.1 model and updated Codex compatibility version.
- Local gateway startup makes Homebrew tools available to plugin hooks when launched from the app.
- Bot drafts keep their own saves up to date, long messages expand after five lines, and pairing uses the gateway tunnel.

Requires Apple Silicon and macOS 26 or later. Gateway protocol remains 88.
